payload.description: Perform a read-only threat model of the proposed portable command-service API and durable-state boundary. Analyze tenant isolation, authentication context, idempotency abuse, replay, command authorization, payload limits, sensitive data, result access, cancellation races, broker trust, confused-deputy risks, auditability, and provider portability. Return required contract safeguards and open decisions without editing source.
payload.title: Threat model the portable command service boundary
